decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the ____________ wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The proposed dormer windows and the proposed roof light shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - The flat roof to the rear of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden, or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a second floor rear extension to house.
